messages:
priya: Heads-up — sales forwarded a private/on-prem intake from VeloHealth. They need VPC + on-prem for PHI, 6-month pilot, must support ~1k req/s peak (100 token avg), HIPAA compliance, HSM-backed KMS, and an airgap during data transfer. Sales asked for feasibility + rough timeline by EOW. They also require no internet egress from the inference cluster and customer-managed KMS. They mentioned on-prem S3 (Ceph) for artifacts. Can product triage?

maya: Thanks — a few clarifying q's before we scope: expected steady qps vs peak? Which GPU types do they have on-prem? Model size / latency SLO? Any mandatory compliance docs?

priya: Sales says peak 1k rps, steady ~250 rps. Model is ~20B (quantizable), latency SLO ~200ms p95. Customer has H100s. Pilot target start = ~8 weeks if greenlit. They want SOC2 + HIPAA attestation available and audit logs exported to their SIEM.

sam: Technical notes: air-gap + HSM + no-egress means either a private control plane (in our managed plane but VPC peered) or a fully offline on-prem bundle + offline control plane. Option 2 requires an installer + 1-2 week onsite window or remote install with customer infra team. Need to validate: kernel modules, container runtime, nvidia drivers, CUDA compatibility, and supported OS distros. Also need to confirm Ceph/S3 compatibility and if they'll provide an S3 endpoint we can write to.

sam: Firewall / port requirements (example) — we'll need these open between control plane <-> data plane, and between nodes for KV cache replication:
```
# minimal ports (example)
TCP 22 (ssh) - install only
TCP 443 - control plane API
TCP 9000 - S3/MinIO endpoint
TCP 8000-8100 - inference runtime gRPC/http (load balanced)
TCP 50051 - internal rpc (if applicable)
UDP 123 - ntp
```
Note: if fully air-gapped, we must bundle certs and not rely on Let's Encrypt. Also offline package will be ~10-15GB (containers + deps).

ada: Security/compliance: HIPAA + HSM: confirm the customer's HSM vendor (Thales, AWS CloudHSM, Yubikey/PKCS11). We need documented KMS integration flow, key rotation policy, and proof of zero data retention on our side for PHI. We also need the threat model and an inventory of who can access the cluster (RBAC). Legal will need a DPA signed.

deploy-bot: Intake checklist updated: [feasibility_requested] [pilot_timeline_requested] [security_review_required] — assigned to maya.

maya: Proposed next steps: 1) Feasibility doc with Option A (private control plane + VPC peering) and Option B (fully on-prem offline install) + rough timelines & risk matrix. 2) Detailed dependency checklist (drivers, repos, S3 endpoint, HSM vendor, firewall rules). 3) Engineering effort estimate + on-site/install support estimate. 4) Customer infra questionnaire to be populated. I'll own the doc. Can we meet Thu 11am to sync? @sam @ada please join. @priya can you push the customer's infra inventory link here?

priya: Adding questionnaire link and initial inventory from sales: https://docs.internal/velohealth-intake (internal). I'll ask sales to confirm exact HSM model and whether the cluster is air-gapped permanently or only during initial data ingestion. ETA for inventory: Tue EOD. Assigning owners: sam = infra validation, ada = security / compliance. Need feasibility doc by Fri COB per sales ask.

sam: Ack — I'll run a drivers/CUDA compatibility matrix today and estimate offline bundle size and install complexity. Also will check Ceph S3 endpoint auth modes (sigv4 vs presigned).

ada: I'll draft the HIPAA/SOC2 checklist and note any blockers that require legal. Expect a first pass by Wed. May need customer to sign DPA before we share certain artifacts.

maya: Summary / owners: sam (infra), ada (security), maya (product owner), priya (sales). Deliverable: feasibility + timeline + blockers list by Fri COB. Meeting Thu 11:00. :thumbsup:
